scope: Stage 4a of the 1st development plan: LSWT entry point on the common model types (solve_lswt), common result header and JSON output, ground-state energy and ordered moment, diagonalization data kept for reuse within a calculation (D24).

solve_lswt, LSWTSettings, LSWTResult, LSWTError; default regularization 'none' with zero-mode detection; half-step shifted mesh of the magnetic reciprocal cell; finite torus momenta reduced to the magnetic cell; H(k), Colpa eigenvalues and paraunitary eigenvectors kept in the result

changed.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/ed/solver: EDResult gains the common header and to_json_dict
changed.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/lswt/__in: exports of the new entry point

regression_vs_LSWTSolver.summary: NBCP One-Four MSL, XXZ and SOC families, same momenta (BrillouinZone.get_full(6)) and MAGSWT

zero_mode_finding: An exact Goldstone mode at the zone centre can give min eig H(k) = +5.6e-16 by round-off; Cholesky then succeeds and returns omega ~ 4e-8 with <n> ~ 1.5e6. Without regularization, min eig H(k) <= 1e-10 max|eig H(k)| is therefore treated as a zero mode and reported (LSWTError).

analytic_lswt.agreement: N = 128 energies within 1e-7; 1/N-extrapolated moment reductions within 3e-7

square_lswt.source: Manousakis, Rev. Mod. Phys. 63, 1 (1991); analytic LSWT integrals

nbcp.summary: Y (0.2 T) and V (1.4 T), XXZ, J_PD, J_Gamma = 0.01 meV: the zone-centred mesh reports the LSWT-order zero mode (accidental degeneracy) at Gamma; the default shifted 24 x 24 mesh needs no regularization.
